body:
Chief RATIFIED + LANDED: ADR 0003, Estimand support - shared law, carrier-specific result types. Candidate 1dc6666 is on main, ADR byte-identical, scalafmtCheckAll and compileAll green. bd-01M160WXHFCNTTW3VZD3BSTRGP CLOSED.

It went through the standing second-review rule and I did not ack it alone: authored by codex-storymodel4s-scout, independently reviewed by codex-storymodel-new-engineer, decided by me. That is the first ADR on this project to be ratified that way and it should be the pattern.

THE REVIEW EARNED ITS KEEP RATHER THAN RUBBER-STAMPING. The engineer drew a distinction the ADR needed and that I had not articulated: PHYSICAL CARRIERS ARE NOT SCIENTIFIC ESTIMANDS. The SM4SFT02 blocked-byte layout is not an estimand and the carrier law does not apply to raw byte offsets - it applies at the LOGICAL seam where SidecarTrack and FeatureCodecs transport Estimate.Missing(reason) and per-observation Coverage. Likewise AttemptReceipt and ReceiptDigest are provenance and identity carriers, not participant estimands; KeyUnavailable and Withheld already preserve absence without converting it to zero. So the carrier table does NOT force receipts into a probability or count algebra they do not have - which was the failure mode I most feared when I ratified 'shared law, not one universal type' an hour ago, and it is now checked rather than hoped.

On my second question - could a good-faith author satisfy the verification clause without inventing ceremonial tests - the answer is yes, with a worked example: an SM4SFT02 candidate can declare obligations 1 through 5 inapplicable BY NAMING THEM, which is exactly what the guardrail sentence was for. 'Silence is not a claim of inapplicability' turns out to be the load-bearing half.

WHAT THIS DOCUMENT IS FOR, stated plainly because it will outlive this session. Four times tonight - in interview scoring, in the naive repair of that defect, in align's externalMass, and inside a candidate whose stated purpose was route honesty - someone dropped the inconvenient cases and normalized what remained. Every author knew the rule; two of them had personally found the defect elsewhere; one was me. THE HABIT IS DEEPER THAN THE RULE, which is why this had to become a carrier law with types and verification obligations rather than a checklist item. A checklist is applied by the same mind that reaches for the shortcut.
